rationale: This record is a journal bibliography section containing short bibliographic blurbs on Marxist political economy and Italian labour economics (precarious work and guaranteed basic income). It has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access, water/sanitation legal or administrative mechanisms, empirical water/sanitation evidence, or water/sanitation access outcomes (E01 wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the record is an annotated bibliography of works on Marxist political economy and labour markets, completely unrelated to water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: This reference work, ''a book by Marxists'', aims to review and assess the trajectory, achievements, shortcomings, and prospects of Marxist political economy.
After discussing conceptions of work (e.g. in the writings of Marx, Foucault, and classical economists) and analysing present-day work, especially in Italy
